rationale: New family registered this iteration — first probabilistic FM in the registry with calibrated Student-t distribution head. Default-shot at MINOR-nudge HPs (channel_indices=[0,1,5], num_samples=50, pred_len=3) flooded to thr=0.0 on 4/5 windows and only W1 produced positive ann (+15.6%). Train mode should sweep pos_weight ∈ [1.0, 1.2] (current 1.5 likely too high — flood is the failure mode), then dropout ∈ [0.10, 0.25] for transition-window regularization, then channel_indices alternatives. Modal cost was ~600-800s per fold = ~$0.30/config so an hourly train_mode sweep is too expensive; cap at 3-5 configs/day or fall back to (0, 1, 5) only.
